title: Covector evaluation on vectors of norm at most one is bounded by P^n times the Euclidean coefficient norm
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every n-covector α on ℝ^P (continuous alternating n-linear form) and every τ_1, …, τ_n ∈ ℝ^P with ‖τ_j‖ ≤ 1 for all j: |α(τ_1, …, τ_n)| ≤ P^n · covectorEuclideanNorm(α), where covectorEuclideanNorm(α) = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_{I(1)}, …, e_{I(n)})²)^{1/2} and e_1, …, e_P is the standard basis.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n) (τ : Fin n → Eucl P), (∀ j, ‖τ j‖ ≤ 1) → |α τ| ≤ (P : ℝ) ^ n * covectorEuclideanNorm α
